subject: Recap & next steps — ACME evaluation kickoff

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & next steps — ACME evaluation kickoff

Hi Sara / Daniel —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through ACME's use cases. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary goals: reduce support response time and automate triage for common customer queries.
- Key constraints: data residency (US), SSO + KMS for secrets, and a firm procurement window in early Dec.

Proposed next step: schedule an evaluation kickoff where we can align on a trial plan, success criteria, and the prompt set/evals we'll use. Connor (copied) will run a short technical deep dive (infrastructure, integration approach, SSO/KMS questions).

I propose two slots next week (PT):
- Tue, Nov 24 — 10:00 AM PT
- Wed, Nov 25 — 1:00 PM PT

If neither works, happy to do Mon/Tue as well. Attached is a draft trial plan to give a sense of timelines and deliverables (redwood-trial-plan.pdf).

Action items:
- Sara / Daniel: confirm preferred slot + who from ACME should join the technical part (infra lead, product owner).
- We'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda once we have a time.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123

Attendees from our side: Sara Lee (product lead), Daniel Ruiz (engineering manager), and possibly Alex Park (infra lead) for the technical deep dive.

A few questions before the kickoff:
- Can you share a short example prompt set so we can review prior to the call?
- Is the trial plan flexible on timelines? Our procurement window is tight — we need a rollout decision by week of Dec 7.

I've copied Connor for the technical bits. Also attaching ACME's signed NDA for reference (acme-signed-nda.pdf).

Hi Marissa / Connor —

Confirmed for Mon, Nov 23 at 11:00 AM PT. Calendar invite accepted: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-eval-kickoff-20261123

Per your request, here's a quick list of initial success criteria we'd use to evaluate the trial:
- 20% reduction in average support response time for templated issues
- >= 85% accuracy on intent classification for our top 10 intents
- Integration with our SSO (SAML) without production data exposure

Initial prompt examples (high level):
1) "Classify support ticket into intents: billing, login, feature_request, bug."
2) "Summarize customer message and return suggested triage labels and priority."

I've attached the signed NDA for records and look forward to the kickoff. Can you send the final trial plan and a short prompt set before the call so we can review?

Thanks,
Sara Lee
Product Lead | ACME Corp
sara.lee@acme.com
